scope: Source-only research for cucuruz→Porumb, gazetă→Ziar, untdelemn→Ulei. No candidate selection, approval, pool, fixture, runtime, or form installation.
evidence_policy: Own short paraphrases and exact lexical facts only. Original publishers are identified per source; search-only leads and unsuccessful retrievals do not become verified evidence. Dictionary presence and commercial exposure are not human recognition tests.

sources.claim: Maize is explicitly a Transylvanian/Banat sense. Other recorded uses include cone, cob, maize field/harvest, underdeveloped maize, Petasites plants, walnut kernel and haystack.

sources.access: Original site search UI read; one result.
sources.claim: Feminine noun; displayed genitive-dative definite gazetei and plural gazete. No restrictive register marker displayed.

sources.claim: The p18 glossary permits either a newspaper or a magazine under gazetă. The p38 classroom lesson places gazetă beside ziar/jurnal for a publication carrying current information. Supports a newspaper sense, not universal equivalence with all periodicals.

sources.original: Publication's own account of its newspaper and online history.
sources.access: Opened article body, especially history and final print/online paragraph.
sources.license: No open reuse license observed; terms link exists. No article text or images copied.
sources.claim: The publisher calls Gazeta Sporturilor a newspaper and states that its printed edition ended in November 2023 while online publishing continues. This is a concrete current and historical Romanian exposure signal, not a general semantic definition.

sources.access: Original site search UI read; one result.
sources.claim: Neuter noun, explicitly bounded to edible vegetable oil. The written form is untdelemn; the plural untdelemnuri is marked for varieties.

sources.access: Original site search UI read; two entries.
sources.claim: Entry 1 has the fatty-liquid sense and variety plural uleiuri. A separate regional entry refers to a tree trunk/container/beehive and has plural uleie. These distinct senses must not be conflated.

sources.original: Broadcaster's own Să vorbim corect column by Marcel Tolcea, posted by Dana Florea 2018-09-14; broadcast dated 2018-08-01.
sources.access: Opened body including the final semantic explanation.
sources.license: No open reuse license observed. Own paraphrase only; the page's image credit does not license the article.
sources.claim: The column distinguishes olive-oil origins from established wider edible-vegetable-oil usage. Its etymological discussion cites Sorin Stati; it is not the original Stati book, and is not used to establish that book's detailed etymology.

sources.original: Manufacturer's own human-consumption vegetable-oil and brand page.

sources.claim: The brand Untdelemn de la Bunica is presented within edible oils and for everyday cooking. Supports current grocery-language exposure; a brand name alone does not establish a dictionary synonym or recognition frequency.

hypotheses.finding: Sense-supported but already-owned; stop research and hold any ownership migration.

morphology.note: The neuter plural is attached to maize-field sense. No exhaustive declension or historical/regional variants are proposed.

hypotheses.scope_limit: Only the maize sense could be considered equivalent to a maize concept. The source explicitly records other senses; no all-senses synonym assertion.

holds: No migration, merge, selection, new-form count or approval from this source note.

hypotheses.finding: Newspaper sense supported by original educational source and publisher usage; global equivalence held because gazetă is broader.

morphology.note: Only explicitly displayed forms are recorded. Forms such as gazeta/gazetele/gazetelor have not been individually sourced here.

hypotheses.scope_limit: The source permits a magazine as well as a newspaper; avoid collapsing all uses of gazetă into Ziar. Publication titles are recognition examples, not blanket synonym rules.

signals: Romanian newspaper's own long-running title and continuing web edition.
recognition.limits: Signals establish real educational/media exposure, not measured broad Romanian recognition. No human playtest evidence. A Romanian Ministry-hosted glossary was not verified.

holds: Root must bind exact Ziar sense and ownership/aliases/deck/rejection state.

hypotheses.finding: Edible-vegetable-oil sense has direct original DOOM support; admit to further sense/identity review only.

morphology.restriction: The plural names varieties. No invented articulated/genitive-dative forms, undelemn variant, or hyphenated unt-de-lemn spelling proposed.

hypotheses.scope_limit: Olive oil is a historically salient narrower use; current source also permits other edible vegetable oils. No support for replacing motor/mineral oil or every possible Ulei sense. The separate regional ulei entry is explicitly excluded.

No blanket approval of all oil senses or all plurals.
